clocks.name: The dot-com calendar
clocks.how: The dot-com run topped in month 54 after Netscape's IPO. Month 54 after ChatGPT.

clocks.name: The 40 line
clocks.how: CAPE first passed 40 in Jan 1999; the Nasdaq topped 13 months later. This time it passed 40 in May 2026.

clocks.name: Valuation at today's pace
clocks.how: CAPE has risen 7% a year over the last two years. At that pace it reaches its 2000 peak of 44.2.

clocks.name: Prices at today's pace
clocks.how: The Nasdaq has risen 25% a year over the last two years. At that pace it reaches the dot-com top: ×4.6 from the start.
